title: Sensitivity Analysis of Decision Rules in an Agent-Based Agro-Ecological Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.22420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. Classical global sensitivity analysis presupposes independent inputs over a fixed Cartesian product and is ill-posed on such a branched space and biased by construction. We instead treat the structure of the decisions as a first-class modelling object. Using advanced surrogate modelling techniques, we encode the crop-management itinerary of the high-resolution agro-ecological modelling platform MAELIA as a hierarchical design space featuring both categorical and numerical variables. translated_title: 基于主体的农业生态模型中决策规则的敏感性分析
translated_abstract: 基于主体的模型非常适合对农业生态系统进行建模以辅助决策，然而要将模拟结果转化为可操作的洞察，需要识别出哪些决策真正驱动了系统行为。在这种背景下，敏感性分析会遇到许多复杂系统的一个结构性特征：参数并不是一个平坦的向量，而是一棵决策树，其中许多参数只有在更高层级的选择激活它们时才会出现。经典的全局敏感性分析预设输入在固定的笛卡尔积上相互独立，因此在这种分支空间上是不适定的，且在构造上存在偏差。我们转而将决策的结构本身作为一等建模对象。利用先进的代理建模技术，我们将高分辨率农业生态建模平台 MAELIA 的作物管理流程编码为一个同时包含分类变量和数值变量的分层设计空间。我们提出
tldr: 该论文提出将复杂系统中的树状分层决策结构作为一等建模对象，利用先进的代理建模技术将农业生态模型 MAELIA 的作物管理决策编码为包含分类与数值变量的分层设计空间，从而克服经典全局敏感性分析在分支参数空间上不适定且有偏差的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper treats hierarchical decision structures as a first-class modelling object, using advanced surrogate modelling to encode MAELIA's crop-management decisions as a hierarchical design space with categorical and numerical variables, thereby overcoming the ill-posedness and bias of classical global sensitivity analysis on branched parameter spaces.
